look_here_first: Start with ray color. Maroon blanketflower is an annual with leafy branching stems and heads carrying dark maroon-red to purple rays, usually without the bright yellow tips common in G. pulchella.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Travis — documented at Pace Bend Park. Llano — multiple documented native records west of Llano / south of San Saba. Williamson — dedicated county treatment documents G. amblyodon.

best_field_traits: dark red to maroon or purple rays
disk florets yellow to dark red with purple tips
morphology_keys.comparison_training: G. pulchella usually has conspicuous yellow-tipped red rays; G. amblyodon is much more uniformly maroon/red. G. suavis is perennial and scapose with rays often reduced or absent.
